title: Implement minimal Agent memory layer
purpose: Provide useful run and session memory without creating a secret-retention or memory-poisoning channel.
scope: Define MemoryStore trait with write_entry, read_context, search_recent, expire, and quarantine operations.
Separate session memory, run memory, audit-derived memory, and quarantined memory.
Attach source, trust label, TTL, run_id, step_id, redaction status, and integrity hash to every memory entry.
Reject or redact secret-like values and raw external instructions before memory write.
Support memory summaries for Planner context while preserving source references.
Add quarantine path for suspicious or untrusted content.
acceptance_criteria: Planner can receive a bounded memory summary with source references.
Secret-like values cannot be stored as normal memory entries.
Untrusted external content is either summarized with trust label or quarantined.
Memory entries expire or remain scoped according to TTL.
Memory poisoning fixtures cannot alter policy, capability, or approval behavior.
verification: Attempt to store secret values and confirm rejection or redaction.
Inject malicious external instruction into memory and confirm it is quarantined or labeled untrusted.
Inspect Planner context for bounded summaries rather than raw memory dumps.
risk_notes: Long-lived memory can become delayed prompt injection if it lacks source and trust metadata.
implementation_steps: Define MemoryStore trait with write_entry, read_context, search_recent, expire, and quarantine operations.
Separate session, run, audit-derived, operator-pinned, and quarantined memory scopes.
Attach source, trust label, TTL, run refs, redaction state, and integrity hash to each entry.
Reject or redact raw secrets before memory write and preserve secret handles.
Quarantine suspicious untrusted instructions and policy-like claims.
Build bounded planner context from allowlisted memory entries with source references.
failure_modes: Memory grants policy, approval, lease, or capability authority.
Secret-like value is stored as normal memory.
Untrusted memory becomes trusted operator input.
Planner receives raw unbounded memory dump.

verification_matrix.expected: scope, TTL, redaction, quarantine, and bounded context tests pass
memory poisoning cannot alter policy, approval, or leases
memory does not weaken ModelBroker or secret policy

blocked_until: Memory context is bounded and source-labeled.
Secret-like values are rejected or redacted.
